about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.undefined-by-ibm: only non-digit data in a numeric USAGE DISPLAY item kills it, and IBM documents no result for that
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.reason: image byte(s) [0] of s_WS_ORIG_DATE_GRP_X lie in no item the program names, so the mutated store is never read (inert-image); attack on record, 14 inputs, no kill

survivors.before: private final Field f41_DUMMYL = Field.binary(s_BNK1MEI, 156, 4, 0, true, false);
survivors.after: private final Field f41_DUMMYL = Field.binary(s_BNK1MEI, 156, 4, 1, true, false);
survivors.reason: f41_DUMMYL is only stored as a text length and read as == -1, which no scale makes true (map-length-scale)
f75_EIBDATE is only stored into and no read EIB item shares its bytes: the stored value is never seen (eib-resp-unread)
f152_EIBDATE is only stored into and no read EIB item shares its bytes: the stored value is never seen (eib-resp-unread)

the mutant stops the PF15 EIBAID byte being stored, but BNKMENU.cbl lines 125-152 test EIBAID only against PA1/PA2/PA3, PF3/PF12, CLEAR and ENTER: a PF15 and an unset EIBAID both take WHEN OTHER, so the byte is unobservable; the pf15 scenario (an invalid-key press) ran against it and did not kill it

survivors.before: throw new DetCics.PastFrom("COMMAREA past EIBCALEN (" + calen + " bytes): not modelled");
survivors.after: throw new DetCics.PastFrom("COMMAREA past EIBCALEN (" + calen + "Xbytes): not modelled");
survivors.reason: a PastFrom message is written to <scenario>.x6 and only classified by x6_judged (EIBCALEN kept, PERFORM_DEPTH absent): the refusal kind and the judged events are the same (refusal-text)
